change: w4a16_lmhead + per-stream SNAC (one SNAC call per window, one worker thread)
notes: Bottleneck: SNAC worker saturates (busy 1.00 from N=8); throughput caps at ~6.7 audio-s/s; N=4 fails only on 3 gaps of <3 ms. vLLM never queued.

change: BatchedChunkDecoder: one SNAC call for all streams' pending windows (max_batch 64, max_wait 0 ms)
notes: SNAC no longer saturated (busy ~0.61, batch mean 3.7-13.9). New bottleneck: GPU contention between SNAC and vLLM (separate processes): vLLM step time in server 1.4-2.3x its standalone time (12.2 ms/token at N=8 = realtime limit); vLLM alone stays realtime up to ~28 streams. N=8 fails (RTF p50 1.02).

change: online fp8 weights (W8A8 CUTLASS), bf16 KV cache
notes: Not realtime even for one stream: 55.5 tok/s = 18.0 ms/token, RTF 1.48 generation-only (corrected in step 1d; realtime needs <= 12.2 ms/token). fp8 weight-only via Marlin: 61.7 tok/s, also too slow. W4A16 (10.9 ms) and W4A16 + 4-bit lm_head (8.1 ms) are faster with no measurable WER loss (step 5), so fp8 was never served or load-tested.
